# External Tribbie model terms

The character-model source is
[aihobbyist/GPT-SoVITS_Model_Collection](https://www.modelscope.cn/models/aihobbyist/GPT-SoVITS_Model_Collection).
The published collection README declares CC-BY-NC 4.0, requires attribution of
all training participants, prohibits commercial use and additionally states
“不得二次配布” (no secondary redistribution). These source statements are
retained together; the inference engine's MIT/Apache licenses do not replace
them or resolve their legal relationship.

Participants named by the source:

- 红血球AE3803 — https://space.bilibili.com/6589795
- 白菜工厂1145号员工 — https://space.bilibili.com/518098961

The source states that character image and voice rights remain with their
original game rights holders. For Tribbie / 缇宝 from Honkai: Star Rail, the
game rights holder is miHoYo / COGNOSPHERE. No permission to redistribute the
character's recordings or voice identity is inferred from the inference code.

The public repository and Release attachments exclude the character PyTorch
weights, converted character ONNX models and external weight files, reference
audio, user recordings and all tensors derived from user reference audio.
The APK has only a hash allowlist for local import, with no bundled character
model and no published download of the private converted Android ZIP.

CC-BY-NC 4.0 source link:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/
